inspectionMethod.png: Pillow dimensions and alpha channel getbbox; no resampling or encoding.
inspectionMethod.corpus: Indexed NPC XML and task JSON; all authored stage XML. Web-compatible normalized portrait aliases, then exact expression lookup.
inspectionMethod.swf: Read FWS/CWS bytes and tag headers. Root labels counted only against root ShowFrame tags; DefineSprite label timelines inspected separately. No ActionScript execution or rendering.
inspectionMethod.hashes: SHA-256 of bytes read; all inventory inputs were reread at end for change detection.
inspectionMethod.snapshotRole: Research evidence for rechecking, not a runtime manifest or release gate.
